helpful_moments.detail: The visible tap-guard instruction translated directly into a successful full-health opening.
Paused map shows receiver checkmarks, JAMMER OFF, selected Extraction, and 23m walking route; visibly closed before travel.
PATH FRONT with ground arrows gave useful orientation after direct stick movement.
Roman numerals, copper coils and OFF status together made remaining boss work readable.

frustrating_moments.detail: Long route travel exposed the player to rear attacks; receiver access did not imply safety.
Holding fire against alternating armor burned nearly all ammo; choosing the next coil and watching flank warnings competed for attention.
Empty magazine and LOADING interrupted fire intent while threats continued; cause of sustained non-firing not resolved.
Detailed end statistics are tightly packed small text at 844x390, although headline results remain clear.

score_scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with clear rough edges; 9 excellent with little observed friction; 10 exceptional across assessed coverage. Holistic overall is judgment, not an arithmetic mean or reward for winning.

score_reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, navigable mobile mission with useful touch assistance, readable goals and strong atmosphere. Dense touch/HUD demands and ammo/phase management create friction. Grade applies only to observed assisted emulation.
score_reasons.controls: Tap-to-aim, a workable forward stick and simultaneous route/fire make combat reachable with two contacts. Frequent threat-turn and target changes still demand attention; sustained fire behavior during travel was not always clear.
score_reasons.gameplay: Memory recovery, changing objectives, alternating boss windows and extraction form a complete short loop. Recovery gives useful respite, but long holds permit significant damage and indiscriminate fire wastes ammo. Manual movement/combat depth only lightly sampled.
score_reasons.presentation: Distinct rain-dark industrial scene, cyan/amber accents, signage, rifle and numbered coils give a consistent identity. Audio and physical rendering quality unassessed.
score_reasons.usability: Handbook, paused map, route assistance, progress checkmarks and explicit fresh-start/result flow worked. Holding route through recovery and handling reload/threat changes requires learning.
score_reasons.readability: Large objective, health and numbered OFF states work well. Small compass, handbook copy, world labels and packed result metrics are demanding at landscape 844x390; dark world silhouettes can blend.
